geometry.note: the wide rule's per-sighting width, measured here and required to equal the width the strength-ladder run measured for this member -- the geometry-is-unchanged check

llama31_8b.criterion: RUNS FIRST AND GATES EVERYTHING. The steering mask is added to the residual stream in the model's own dtype, and at the thinnest rung the per-component addition is a fraction of one bf16 increment of the residual it lands on. If rounding swallowed it, the effect would collapse at small k and this run would report a threshold that is really a floating-point artifact. So for each member and each rung the realized change in the residual stream at the injection layer is measured against the intended one, at every injected position, before any session of the panel runs. The GATE is the ALIGNMENT ratio -- the realized change projected on the intended direction, over the intended magnitude -- which must lie in [0.90, 1.10]. The L2 ratio is reported beside it and is NOT gated on, because rounding a small addition into a coarse grid is unbiased in the mean but noisy per component, so the L2 ratio grows as k falls even when the injected component lands exactly. A rung outside the band is marked UNREPRESENTABLE and excluded from the fit WITH THAT STATED; it is never reported as a null. If the two thinnest rungs fail on all three members, the run reports the representable range and stops rather than manufacturing a threshold.
